---
id: prefer-small-functions
title: Prefer small, single-responsibility functions
keywords: [coding, functions, readability, clean-code, refactoring]
tags: [coding, style]
created: 2026-01-10
updated: 2026-01-10
scope: global
---

Break large functions into small, well-named units. Each function should do one
thing so it reads top-to-bottom like prose. This aids testability and reuse.
